Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CARTRIDGES FOR SHOT GUNS 

PART 3 CASE EMPTY 



1 . Scope — Covers dimensional and material requirements of case empty for shot gun cartridges. 

2. Dimensions — As given in Tabie 1 .

3. Material 

3.1 Body — The tube made by roiling cartridge paper on mandrel and securing it with case in glue. 
Important requirements of cartridge paper are given in Appendix A and that of casern glue in 
Appendix B. 

3.2 Head — Made from brass strip conforming to Grade Cu Zn 30 of IS : 3168-1981 'Specification for 
brass strip and foil for deep drawing {first revision )\ It shall be chrome passivated. 



Adopted 28 August 1984 



© January 1985, 181 



Gr 3 



JNDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION 
MANAK BHAVAN. 9 BAHADUR SHAH ZAFAR MARG 

NEW DELHI 110002 



IS: 10994 ( Parts ) -1984 



3.3 Cup — Made from tin plate conforming to best cake grade deep-stamping quality with minimum 
tin coating of 35 g/m* of IS ; 597-1978 'Specification for pack rolled tin plate and pack roiled black- 
plate ( second rev is f on )' or grade E 5'6/5'6 of IS : 1993-1974 'Specification for cold-reduced tin plate 
and cold-reduced blackplate ( ff'rst revision )\ 

3.4 Cap Chamber — Made from brass strip conforming to grade Cu Zn 30 of IS : 3168-1981. It shall 
be chrome passivated. 

3.5 Base Wad — Made from paper conforming to the requirements given in Appendix C. 

4. Other Requirements — As given in IS : 10994 ( Part 1 )-1984 'Specification for cartridges for shot 
guns: Part 1 General requirements'.

Carry out blank tests under 
identical conditions and apply 
the necessary corrections.

IS : 10994 ( Parts ) - 1984 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Case empty forms the body of the cartridges for shot guns. 

In preparation of this standard ( Part 3 ) considerable assistance has been derived from the 
foUowing: 

JSS : 1224 Paper for cartridge, Directorate of Standardization, Ministry of Defence, New Delhi. 

JSS 1-78.04 Paper for base wads. Directorate of Standardization, Ministry of Defence, New 
Delhi. 

IND/ME/381 Casein glue, CIME Pune, Ministry of Defence, New Delhi, 

This Indian Standard ( IS : 10994 ) is being issued in the following parts. Part 1 covering general 
requirements for shot gun cartridges and subsequent parts covering the individual components; 



Part 1 


General requirements 


Part 2 


Blank cartridges 


Part 3 


Case empty 


Part 4 


Cap filled 


Part 5 


Anvil 


Part 6 


Propellent 


Part 7 


Discs 


Part 8 


Air cushion 


Part 9 


Lead shots 



This standard was prepared based on the information provided by the Ammunition Factory, 
Khadhi, Pune. 



Printed at Printrade,New Delhi. India
